title: kbjob.py submit queues one job per clone, operation and subject, and a second submit returns the live job
goal: python3 _tools/kbjob.py [--store PATH] submit OP [SUBJECT] [--by claude-<8 hex>] [--option KEY=VALUE]... queues a job and prints one JSON object {job, state, deduped, seq, follow}: the key job/JB-<8 chars> holds {job, op, subject, host, clone, operator, by, options, state, attempt, submitted_ts}, moved none to queued by ST-hojylkmb's table; OP is one of the closed table kj_ops.OPS (land with the options wait_merge and trailer, done with commit and trailer, stage-back with check, self_reviewed and trailer, sync-push, check with --name one of backlog-check, tests-full, tests-changed), a backlog id is the SUBJECT of the first three and sync-push and check take none; an unknown operation (publish, answer), a subject that is no item of the clone, an option outside the operation's list or a --by that is no claude-<8 hex> exits 2 naming what is allowed; a second submit of the same clone, operation and subject (options aside) while the job is queued, running, waiting-lock, waiting-merge or lost returns the same job with deduped true, also when four submits race (one job), and after a terminal state a submit makes a new job with attempt raised by one; kj_store.submit(root, op, subject, by, options=None, store=None) returns that object and kj_store.status(root, job, since=0, store=None) returns {job, state, exit, step, log, events, last}, the one interface the MCP server calls

run: import sys,os,tempfile,subprocess; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import kj_store; s=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),"c.sqlite"); a=kj_store.submit(".","land","ST-hojylkmb","claude-0123abcd",{"wait_merge":60},store=s); b=kj_store.submit(".","land","ST-hojylkmb","claude-0123abcd",None,store=s); assert a["state"]=="queued" and a["deduped"] is False and b["job"]==a["job"] and b["deduped"] is True, (a,b); run=lambda *x: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbjob.py","--store",s,"submit",*x],capture_output=True,text=True); assert run("publish","ST-hojylkmb").returncode==2; assert run("land","ST-nosuchit").returncode==2; assert run("land","ST-hojylkmb","--by","0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef").returncode==2; assert run("land","ST-hojylkmb","--option","force=1").returncode==2
